rationale: The candidate reads as one coherent compact mass with a clear carved-through internal void, and it responds reasonably well to the parcel by leaving a legible perimeter figure rather than just filling the bounding box. The blue access edge is answered by an open seam/cut that is semantically compatible with a public threshold, so the ground condition is strong. The main weakness is sectional: the top/void relationship is relatively shallow and box-derived, so it lacks the stronger roof/section logic seen in the references. It also has a slightly repetitive stepped/cut profile that is coherent but not especially expressive as a capacity-bearing section. Overall it is program-fit for neighborhood living, but more convincing as a street building than as a fully developed sectional massing.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: The candidate is simpler and more boxy; do not copy the scalloped roof language or decorative curvature.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Three-part low-rise mass with a central void and a bridge-like upper connector can create a legible public threshold while keeping a compact dominant body.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: This reference is a larger campus-like ensemble; the candidate should not fragment into separate buildings.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: A courtyard/plaza-centered composition can organize multiple masses around one public interior figure.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: The candidate lacks the same clarity of section and overhang articulation.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: A shallow central cut and overhanging upper mass can produce active ground openness without losing a compact street edge.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: The candidate is not as horizontally extended or roof-expressive.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: A long, low mass with a courtyard void and a folded roof line can read as neighborhood-serving mixed-use.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: The candidate is more compact and less topographically layered.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Connected wings around a core void and a terrace-like section can support public circulation and communal identity.
